nodes.name: Schedule Trigger
nodes.notes: Triggers at 8:00 AM ET on weekdays (Mon-Fri). Server timezone must be set to America/New_York.

nodes.name: Fetch System Status
nodes.notes: Fetches current system status including agent states and killswitch status

nodes.name: Fetch Yesterday Trades
nodes.notes: Fetches all trades from yesterday for P&L calculation

nodes.name: Fetch Agent Status
nodes.notes: Fetches status of all trading agents

nodes.name: Fetch Open Positions
nodes.notes: Fetches current open positions across all brokers

nodes.name: Fetch Fear Greed Index
nodes.notes: Fetches Crypto Fear & Greed Index for market sentiment

nodes.name: Fetch Economic Calendar
nodes.notes: Fetches economic events from ForexFactory for today

nodes.name: Merge All Data
nodes.notes: Combines all parallel API responses into single item for processing

nodes.name: Calculate Metrics
nodes.notes: Calculates all metrics from raw data: P&L, win rate, agent health, exposure, market sentiment

nodes.name: Check Data Quality
nodes.notes: Validates that we have meaningful data before generating briefing

nodes.name: Generate AI Briefing
nodes.notes: Calls Claude API to generate intelligent morning briefing from metrics

nodes.name: Generate Fallback Briefing
nodes.notes: Generates a simple fallback message when data quality is insufficient

nodes.name: Merge Briefing Paths
nodes.notes: Combines AI briefing and fallback paths

nodes.name: Format Discord Embed
nodes.notes: Formats the briefing as a rich Discord embed with color-coded status

nodes.name: Post to Discord
nodes.notes: Posts the formatted briefing embed to #ceo-briefing Discord channel

nodes.name: Log to Audit Trail
nodes.notes: Logs briefing event to audit trail for historical tracking

nodes.name: Check Critical Alerts
nodes.notes: Checks if system health is CRITICAL to trigger escalation

nodes.name: Send Critical Alert
nodes.notes: Sends critical alert to #alerts channel with @mention for urgent issues

nodes.name: Workflow Complete
nodes.notes: End node - workflow completed successfully

nodes.name: Error Handler
nodes.notes: Catches any errors in this workflow

nodes.name: Format Error Message
nodes.notes: Formats error details for Discord notification

nodes.name: Post Error to Discord
nodes.notes: Posts error notification to #n8n-errors channel
